subject.title: [Bug]: Inherited OpenAI OAuth (read-through from main) rejected at provider for built-in openclaw runtime on openai-chatgpt-responses transport, while main succeeds with the same profile

question: Should #98702 be closed as fixed by PR #100233 without a current-main live OAuth retest, or kept open until the reporter/current-main probe proves the fast auth failure is gone?
rationale: The source and dependency contract point to PR #100233 as a strong candidate, but the issue symptom is provider auth rejection rather than the prompt-cache miss directly proven by that PR.

options.title: Keep Open For Retest
options.body: Keep #98702 open and ask for the exact redacted `models status --probe` pair on a build containing PR #100233 before closing.

options.title: Close On Source Proof
options.body: Close as fixed by current main if maintainers accept the session-affinity header source proof as sufficient despite no direct auth-failure retest.

options.title: Split Follow-Up
options.body: Open a narrower follow-up only if the current-main retest still shows non-main ChatGPT Responses OAuth auth failing.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Retest
recommendation.body: Keep #98702 open and ask for the exact redacted `models status --probe` pair on a build containing PR #100233 before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses OpenAI auth/profile behavior and provider transport proof, where recent history points to steipete as the strongest adjacent owner signal.
